messages:
alex.chen: heads-up — bigbank (dedicated) seeing retries & p99 spike since 11:40 PST. CS has escalated to SEV. Need an engineering workaround + clear owner by EOD :exclamation:

deploy-bot: alert triggered: bigbank-dedicated-pool p99 latency > 1500ms (3/5 nodes) at 11:41

maria.gomez: @alex.chen any initial hypothesis? logs/trace id? :eyes:

alex.chen: seeing increased tail on embed requests and occasional 503s on pool-3. trace id 0x9a3f attached in logs. Also routing fallback hasn't tripped.

sanjay.rao: I'm available to own rollback to model-variant v1-quant-lite — that should reduce memory pressure. Need green on QA push.

emily.park: if we rollback we'll need to flip feature flag 'routing.fallback.model_override' and clear prefix cache. I can handle the feature flag flip once owner + approval.

jonathan.s: tagging infra: @sre-team — can you confirm there's no node-level OOM? Running `kubectl top` shows high GPU mem on node-7

sre-team: node-7 GPU memory at 98%. Evicting pods not safe. Reboot window not immediate.

maria.gomez: can we temporarily route bigbank to dedicated-burst (lower perf but stable) via route policy? If so, who owns the change?

sanjay.rao: I can cut the route change (small config) and roll back if needed. Plan: 1) flip route to dedicated-burst, 2) flip model_override to v1-quant-lite, 3) monitor for 15m. If stable, follow up with patch to tune batch size.

alex.chen: agreed. Sanjay owns. Emily will do feature flag, Jonathan coordinate with SRE for watch. Maria — please update CS with ETA ~30m and link this thread.

maria.gomez: on it. I'll tell them ETA 30m and owners: sanjay.rao, emily.park, jonathan.s. Also pinging product to expect potential slight latency delta :wave:

emily.park: preparing flag change now. posting the command I'll run:
```
# enable model override for bigbank route
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/route/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_API_TOKEN' -d '{"route":"bigbank","override":"v1-quant-lite"}'
```

alex.chen: also want a CR PR ping — sanjay please reference PR 6721 for the batch-size tweak, need review from infra and ml-eval.

sanjay.rao: noted. I'll submit a small PR after the immediate rollback. @emily.park lmk when flag is flipped so I can proceed.

deploy-bot: runbook update: created incident ticket INC-2026-1176 and added runbook link https://go/ri/runbooks/bigbank-retry

jonathan.s: SRE will stand by for 30m. No reboot for now. Watching metrics: https://metrics.internal/bigbank

alex.chen: thanks all. Check back in 15m for status. If regressions persist we'll escalate to oncall lead and consider customer compensation talk.

maria.gomez: updated CS notes and included incident ticket. :thumbsup:

sanjay.rao: done with route flip. monitoring now. will report in 5.

emily.park: flag flipped and cache cleared. logs show reduced memory allocs. :party-parrot:

alex.chen: great — keep this thread for follow-up. We'll capture the postmortem if EOD escalation persists.
